reviewer_statement: I accept the P0.2 owner-review packet and its recorded limitations.
accepted_limitations: The numeric values are deliberately permissive experiment-safety ceilings. They are not evidence that the runtime meets a useful product size, startup, memory, or lifecycle budget.
No C, Emscripten, sanitizer, fuzzer, Wasm, browser, semantic, performance, or lifecycle experiment was run for this review.
The exact native/Wasm instrumentation combinations remain subject to later support probes; an unsupported combination must be retained as a reviewed negative result rather than silently omitted.

The Phase 3 draft manifest schema still models the earlier coarse artifact and memory fields. P0.3 review must align it with the accepted encoded/expanded, per-BEAM, fixed-memory, URL, and message-byte bounds before P0-A03 can pass.
Browser-process RSS is an external harness observation, not a portable in-page browser API; its exact sampler and resolution must be recorded by the owning later experiment.
Numeric product budgets and their accountable authority remain intentionally deferred until after P6 and before C1.
scope_effect: P0-A02 may close only after a valid contract_research evidence record binds the clean committed reviewed inputs; P0-A03, P0-GATE, runtime execution, instrumentation qualification, and product-budget approval remain open.
